description: Örtliche Bauvorschrift "Hamburger Straße - Hauptstraße" is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
